reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for monitoring account balance and estimated current-session API costs using the official DeepSeek API and local session usage data.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中查看账户余额，并根据当前会话用量估算和展示会话费用。
summaries.en: View your DeepSeek account balance and estimate and display the current session cost in DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Reads DeepSeek account balance through the official API
Reads session token usage from the DSH session projection
Calculates estimated session costs using configured pricing data
Displays balance and estimated cost in the DSH interface
Sends the configured DeepSeek API key to api.deepseek.com
